newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BERGKAMP TO MISS WELSH MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BERGKAMP TO MISS WELSH MATCH.

text.p: Injury has forced Dutch striker Dennis Bergkamp out of Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Wales.

The Arsenal forward was named in the squad despite having missed his club side's last four games with a hamstring strain, but he was unable to train on Thursday prompting coach Guus Hiddink to rest him for the group seven match in Cardiff.
"I decided last night not to play Dennis. His injury appeared rather weak and he could only do the warm-up exercises," Hiddink said.
Celtic striker Pierre Van Hooydonk may take Bergkamp's place, but the coach stressed he would not name his side until just before kick-off.
Ajax defender Winston Bogarde is carrying an injury to his left foot but Hiddink said he would "probably be available".
